item.title: [NEW] Follow shows in Apple Podcasts on iPhone and iPad
item.description:
Follow your favorite shows in Apple Podcasts on iPhone and iPad, or unfollow a show and choose what to do with your downloaded episodes.

item.title: [NEW] View episode transcripts in Apple Podcasts on iPhone and iPad
item.description:
With Apple Podcasts on iPhone and iPad, you can follow along with time-synched transcripts, find links to relevant content mentioned in the show, and more.

item.title: [NEW] See your Apple Card recurring transactions
item.description:
In the Wallet app, you can see upcoming transactions, review what you've been charged before, and keep track of your recurring spending on your Apple Card.

item.description:
iCloud Shared Albums supports a wide range of photo and video file types and formats.

item.title: [NEW] How to save photos from a shared album
item.description:
If you want to save a photo or video from a shared album in the Photos app, add it to your photo library.

item.description:
macOS 27 Golden Gate is the latest major version of the Mac operating system. You can install it on any of these Mac models.

item.title: [NEW] Shared Albums limits
item.description:
Depending on the software version in which you create a shared album, there are limits to the number of photos, albums, and invites that you can share.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] Create a temporary shared album on iPhone, iPad, Mac, or Apple Vision Pro
item.description:
Starting in version 27 or later of iOS, iPadOS, macOS, and visionOS, you can create temporary shared albums on your iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro or on iCloud.com to share photos and videos for 30 days.

Apple Support · Other language

item.title: [NEW] If you see Error 110 when restoring your iPhone or iPad
item.description:
Learn what causes Error 110 when you restore your iPhone or iPad, and how to resolve it.

item.title: [NEW] If you can't see your shared album
item.description:
Learn what to do if you can't see your shared album, your shared album isn't syncing, or you can't interact with your shared album.

Apple Support · Other language

item.title: [NEW] About Impersonation Risk Detection
item.description:
Impersonation Risk Detection can help protect you from scams by detecting suspicious activity in real time.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] Use Ask to Browse to approve the websites your child can access
item.description:
Screen Time comes with parental controls — like Ask to Browse — so when your child wants to visit a new website in Safari and other supported browser apps on their iPhone, iPad, or Mac, they have to ask for your approval. Each approved website gets added to the allowed list, which you can adjust at any time.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] If an app continues running in the background after you quit it
item.description:
Starting in macOS 27 Golden Gate, your Mac shows you when an app continues running in the background after you quit it. The first time this happens with an app, you see a notification. Additionally, you see an indication that it's running in the background when you hover over the icon in the Dock.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] Age requirements for managing an Apple Account in Australia
item.description:
Some Apple Account settings and feature requirements for children, teens, and adults will vary depending on your country or region.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] How to upgrade to macOS 27 Golden Gate
item.description:
macOS 27 introduces Siri AI powered by Apple Intelligence, new parental controls, and an expansive set of improvements that make your Mac even more responsive, reliable, and delightful.

Apple Support · Other language

item.title: [NEW] If a Freeform link isn't working
item.description:
If you received a link to Freeform content and it won't open, open the link on a supported Apple device, update your supported device, and make sure to turn on iCloud for Freeform.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] How to use Apple Music Sing on your iPhone, iPad, or Apple TV
item.description:
With your Apple Music subscription, view perfectly timed lyrics and adjust the vocals so that you can sing along. Learn how to use Apple Music Sing on your iPhone, iPad, or Apple TV.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] How to get Siri AI
item.description:
Siri AI (Beta) is an entirely new version of Siri powered by the next generation of Apple Intelligence, and deeply integrated across your Apple devices. A more capable and conversational assistant, Siri AI can answer questions about almost anything and help you find what you need in the moment.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] How to set up Family Sharing on your Mac
item.description:
With Family Sharing, you and up to five family members can share access to Apple services like iCloud+, Apple Music, Apple TV, and more — without sharing an Apple Account. You can even help locate each other’s missing devices, share your location, and manage a child's device with Screen Time and parental controls.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] If you can't add cards to Apple Wallet because of security reasons
item.description:
Get help if you can't add payment cards to Apple Wallet due to security reasons.

Apple Support

Learn about your options for AppleCare coverage for your Apple device.

item.title: [NEW] Use Tap to Share on your iPhone in store
item.description:
Tap to Share lets you securely exchange information with a merchant's iPhone during in-store checkout. Share only what you want to share — like your address for delivery or your email for store signups — and review your checkout cart in real time on your phone.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] If Messages is indexing and shared links and photos don’t appear in your conversations
item.description:
If you can’t find photos from your conversations or see an alert about Messages indexing, you might need to check your iCloud settings for Messages.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] Check device eligibility for AppleCare coverage
item.description:
If you want to get AppleCare coverage for your device, you might need to confirm that the device is in good condition first.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] If you receive an authentication failed message in Mail on iOS
item.description:
Your iPhone can’t verify your email username and password with your email provider, and you might need to enter your credentials again.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] Get AppleCare One for your Family Sharing group
item.description:
You can get AppleCare One Family to cover all eligible Apple devices in your Family Sharing group for one monthly price.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] AirPort Utility availability and compatibility
item.description:
Apple has discontinued AirPort Utility, which was used to configure and update AirPort Time Capsule, AirPort Extreme Base Station, and AirPort Express Base Station. Here’s how to get AirPort Utility if you still need it.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] Use Call Context in the Phone app
item.description:
With Call Context, you can view relevant information when you call certain businesses. This can include tickets, orders, and confirmation numbers.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] Create a pass using Siri Mode in Apple Wallet
item.description:
Use Siri Mode in the Camera app to scan a barcode or QR code, or take a screenshot of a digital code, to create and store passes in the Wallet app.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] If you're missing comments or likes in a shared album
item.description:
If you can't see comments or likes in a shared album in the Photos app, check System Status and your internet connection.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] Update your Apple Pay information
item.description:
Update your billing and contact information that Apple Pay uses for in-app and online purchases.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] Split the bill with Apple Cash
item.description:
Learn how to request or send Apple Cash using a receipt.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] Understand your readiness score on Apple Watch
item.description:
In the Readiness app on Apple Watch Series 12 and Apple Watch Ultra 4, you can view a readiness score and a classification that helps you understand your capacity to take on activities during the day.

Apple Support · Other language

item.title: [NEW] What's new in the updates for macOS 27 Golden Gate
item.description:
macOS 27 updates improve the stability, performance, or compatibility of your Mac and are recommended for all macOS 27 users.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] If some third-party Apple Watch apps disappear after updating to watchOS 27
item.description:
With watchOS 27, all apps are required to include 64-bit support to ensure the best performance. If a third-party app hasn't been updated for 64-bit support, it won't appear on your Apple Watch after you update to watchOS 27.

Apple Support · Other language

item.title: [NEW] About Connectivity Assist
item.description:
Use cellular data in addition to Wi-Fi for a more reliable internet connection.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] Edit a calendar event with Siri AI on iPhone
item.description:
Make changes to an event on your calendar, without opening the Calendar app.

Apple Support

item.title: [NEW] If Apple School Manager asks you to approve new terms and conditions
item.description:
Apple sometimes updates the macOS, iOS, iPadOS, visionOS, or tvOS Software License Agreement, often when releasing a new OS version. When a Software License Agreement is updated, an Apple School Manager Administrator must sign in to the program web portal to review and agree to the updated terms.

Apple Support · Other language
